html:
IDEA Research's Grounding DINO and OpenMMLab's MM-Grounding-DINO (tiny, base; Swin backbone, BERT text encoder): open-vocabulary detector, finds boxes for class names given as text at call time (default: the 80 COCO classes). Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-Training for Open-Set Object Detection, ECCV 2024, 2023-03-09 (for grounding-dino-tiny, grounding-dino-base)
  • Paper: An Open and Comprehensive Pipeline for Unified Object Grounding and Detection, arXiv, 2024-01-04 (for mm-grounding-dino-tiny, mm-grounding-dino-base)
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers at c4c4605f9618
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/IDEA-Research/GroundingDINO (PyTorch): fastforks follows the Hugging Face transformers port, which loads the IDEA-Research/grounding-dino-* weights, instead of the authors' repository.
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection (PyTorch): The MM-Grounding-DINO authors' code lives in MMDetection; fastforks follows the Hugging Face transformers port that loads the converted weights.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/IDEA-Research/grounding-dino-tiny/blob/a2bb814dd30d776dcf7e30523b00659f4f141c71/README.md
  • Training data: Objects365 (train, box annotations) (Grounding DINO-T: Objects365, GoldG (Flickr30k Entities + GQA / Visual Genome images) and Cap4M (web image-caption pairs with pseudo-boxes); GoldG and Cap4M have no dataset id here (paper arXiv:2303.05499 table 2; the authors' model table).)
    • grounding-dino-base: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), Objects365 (train, box annotations) (Grounding DINO-B: COCO, Objects365, GoldG (Flickr30k Entities + GQA / Visual Genome images), Cap4M (web image-caption pairs with pseudo-boxes), OpenImages, ODinW-35 and RefCOCO; only COCO and Objects365 have dataset ids here (the authors' model table, github.com/IDEA-Research/GroundingDINO README).)
    • mm-grounding-dino-tiny: Objects365 (train, box annotations) (MM-Grounding-DINO-T (o365v1_goldg_v3det): Objects365 v1, GoldG (Flickr30k Entities + GQA / Visual Genome images) and V3Det; no COCO, so its COCO numbers are zero-shot (mmdetection configs/mm_grounding_dino README; paper arXiv:2401.02361).)
    • mm-grounding-dino-base: Objects365 (train, box annotations) (MM-Grounding-DINO-B (o365v1_goldg_v3det): Objects365 v1, GoldG (Flickr30k Entities + GQA / Visual Genome images) and V3Det; no COCO, so its COCO numbers are zero-shot (mmdetection configs/mm_grounding_dino README; paper arXiv:2401.02361).)
  • Options: score_threshold = 0.25 (0.0 to 1.0), max_detections = 100 (>= 1)
  • Kernel libraries: none (not built yet: fp16-accumulate GEMMs gain nothing (tiny 112.5 vs 112.5 ms, base 127.6 vs 131.3 ms at 480x640); the time is in the deformable attention (grid_sample) and many small ops, which needs a multi-scale deformable attention kernel and per-size CUDA graphs)
  • Variants: grounding-dino-tiny, grounding-dino-base, mm-grounding-dino-tiny, mm-grounding-dino-base
  • Outputs: boxes, scores, labels; label_set: coco-80
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): grounding-dino-tiny 3000x4000 (1.3 GiB peak allocated, 1.5 reserved); grounding-dino-base 3000x4000 (1.5 GiB peak allocated, 1.7 reserved); mm-grounding-dino-tiny 3000x4000 (1.3 GiB peak allocated, 1.5 reserved); mm-grounding-dino-base 3000x4000 (1.5 GiB peak allocated, 1.7 reserved)
  • grounding-dino-tiny 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 73 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • grounding-dino-base 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 98 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • mm-grounding-dino-tiny 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 71 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • mm-grounding-dino-base 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 105 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • grounding-dino-tiny original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; transformers GroundingDinoForObjectDetection + processor (CPU), coco-80 caption, text tower per call
  • grounding-dino-base original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; transformers GroundingDinoForObjectDetection + processor (CPU), coco-80 caption, text tower per call
  • mm-grounding-dino-tiny original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; transformers MMGroundingDinoForObjectDetection + processor (CPU), coco-80 caption, text tower per call
  • mm-grounding-dino-base original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; transformers MMGroundingDinoForObjectDetection + processor (CPU), coco-80 caption, text tower per call
  • grounding-dino-tiny load / first call: original 4.06 s / 1.176 s, portable 3.01 s / 0.508 s
  • grounding-dino-base load / first call: original 4.16 s / 0.989 s, portable 3.29 s / 0.527 s

  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Limitations

  • Requires the optional transformers library (the network is its GroundingDinoForObjectDetection).
  • The original in the benchmarks and goldens is the Hugging Face transformers 5.19.0 port with the authors' weights (IDEA-Research/grounding-dino-, openmmlab-community/mm_grounding_dino_); the official GroundingDINO and mmdetection code (their CUDA deformable-attention ops) was not run.
  • Class names are joined into one caption of at most 256 tokens (about 100 short names); a longer list raises an error instead of being split into several passes.
  • No phrase output: labels index into the given names (the token-level text threshold of the Hugging Face post-processing is not used).
  • grounding-dino-base was trained with COCO (and RefCOCO, ODinW) data: its COCO numbers are not zero-shot.
